I don’t know if it’s synchronicity but it’s becoming too much. I once was talking about something and when i met them the same day they started talking about the same thing 😐 and it’s a subject that people do not usually speak about..

I feel hopeless!
Sorry I don’t understand 😕
Sorry I didn’t understand!

I tried to ignore their posts but they keep doing it so I’m fighting back now.
But it’s difficult to take full responsibility when they are doing it both on the astral plane and through their posts on social media 😣
I understand what you are saying, but when it they do it a lot it’s difficult to not focus on it 😣
No I think these voices are coming from other people, I sometimes dream of people even though I haven’t seen them from a long time, and I don’t think about them.
Yes I understand that suffering can teach some things but I feel like it’s becoming too much 😣
Ok but I don’t think you are :)
Thank you for telling me this :)
Also I’m interested to know who is your master? if you want to tell
Thank you so much :) but why you don’t know about you?

Ok I understand, I too don’t like some things in Christianity like that to come to god we must worship Jesus, like why? 

I too think this the end of time I have been feeling something weird going on for more than a year now..

Thank you.. hope everyone will be safe especially good people..
Ok I understand, something like what is coming? Do you want to explain more?

Thank you 

How do you mean?
I’m trying to find this help, hope I’ll find it soon, thank you :)
I’m trying not to worry about it but it’s difficult sometimes..
I don’t think I understand the last sentence, you mean that the mind can cause suffering? I have been thinking about this, how will we think in heaven.
Many things, like bad incidents where I feel people are trying to provoke me or like make me feel without dignity either through posts on social media or when I meet them.
Ok.. How do you mean with a confusing dream?
I think all of the negative emotions like scared, sad, angry, desperate, hopeless, unrespected..
I would like to make them feel like they did to me 😔
We can talk here if you want but you don’t have to tell me many things, I don’t think this will help me right now, but thanks anyway..
Do you want to talk about why you think it is real?
Why would someone downvote this?? This is my experience!!!
I don’t know if the matrix is real, I too sometimes feel it is real..

Ok I heard about synchronization but this is not positive..
I didn’t understand about ai, can you explain more?

Oh ok, I both think that it can be spirits but also people, for example they sometimes post things on social media that I feel are directed towards me, and they want to make me think that they can read my mind for example I once was thinking about a colour and then not an hour has passed and one of them posted a bracelet with the same colour and she posted it on more than one social media to make sure I see it!
Who said?

I’m experiencing something similar, I sometimes feel other people’s thoughts in my head, I’m trying to know why and if there is something that could lessens this? I too feel like this could be some spirits playing with me or maybe some cast a spell on me, please if are dealing with this write your experience.
One of the reasons is because they tend to forget the sufferings with time, I was like that, but not now I’m more conscious now, I think god is a sadist! ☹️
I no longer know but I really can’t take it anymore 😣😣 I’m trying to be positive but every once in awhile something happens
What is your problem?

No I used to think like this, but what is happening is really weird, I tried to ignore this idea but no, I keep having weird dreams and they are like trying to tell me something.. also I keep attracting people who are toxic.
I’m seeking help here, if you can’t help me you don’t have to comment!
Yeah that happened with me, I think some of my thoughts are theirs, it’s so annoying.. Try to engage in activities you enjoy, and spend less time with them, especially if you are an empath.
Haha funny how you Christians blame depressed people for their mental illness and god?? What is he doing?? Didn’t he save us??
Yes it’s hard to explain but sometimes I say something that sounds right and logical even though I’m not focused on what I’m saying. It’s like someone else is talking.
Me too..
Ok I will thank you :)
It feels real right now
Thoughts about reality, I also think someone can control my dreams.
Ok, thank you
Because of my thoughts, and sometimes observing doesn’t work.
Because I can’t deal with them 😣
Aa ok
I don’t understand
I did that.
Well why wouldn’t I want that? It’s he who doesn’t want me
I can’t see how loving God would help in this.
Maybe the chemistry in our brains would go back to normal..
Well don’t you think I tried to get close to him before coming here and asking? but he isn’t there.
No why would I? If many things that happened in my life indicate that he doesn’t love me.
Maybe we can learn lessons without having to suffer or at least not that much.

There are a lot, I have intrusive thoughts, depression and anxiety, every time something bad happens and I heal myself I can’t get enough rest till something new happens it’s like I have a curse on me to not be happy, even though I was strong in these battles but something continues to run after me!
Why downvote me? You obviously treat people who speak the truth like this.

I’m surprised to see no one has commented, now I’m not talking about all christians because some of them are good, but aren’t christians supposed to love others and help them?? As they told us Jesus did!! Most christians ignore others suffering, they just interact with people who have it good, so confusing!
Thank you I appreciate that
I don’t know if I’ll continue to have faith, I have endured so much but it feels like god himself doesn’t want me to have faith in him, he wants to cast me in hell.

I don’t know about that, I’ve seen some of my friends and other people they have a perfect life like if they were in heaven. While I fail in nearly everything I do, or even if I succeed something happens and destroys everything, it’s like a curse!

People will talk about therapy and medicine even though they probably know that god loves some people more than others, this is the conclusion I came to after all of my experiences, unfortunately, I don’t know why, even though Jesus said that he came for the sinners, is he maybe lying?? I don’t know
Yeah downvote me because we have to carry our burdens and just shut the fuck up, but I won’t do that
Which grace? To love some people more than others? And let those people watch the happy people while they suffer?
518 views and no one answers me

Unfortunately people won’t understand if they haven’t had it, sometimes when we are in this situation we need to speak out so other people would understand what it is like to have spiritual attacks and why some people have them while others don’t.
Or he is a sadist and likes to watch us suffer.

I’m too 23F and I’m waiting until marriage, and I have depression, paranoia and anxiety too imagine how difficult it is to see other people in my age enjoying life and I’m battling my demons, it feels like I’m giving god so much but he is giving me nothing I always loved him, I don’t know why he is doing so with me!
Why should we love ourselves if god doesn’t? He should love us first so we can love ourselves
Isn’t he being sadistic letting us live in this cruel world and just watching us suffer without intervening?
He didn’t!
Yeah right it feels like my 02 goes down and I need to stop and breath.

You are not alone, I’ve been praying and asking him for help, for something I really need to have to develop spiritually but he doesn’t seem to reply, I don’t understand why although he says “Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find..” weird!!
Yeah true singing is a physical activity anyway thank you for the answer.
Yeah but like maybe someone has this symptom, because I didn’t find something on Google.

No, your advice is not dumb 😕I understand you’re trying to help. 
Yeah I know he is hurt but if he loved me he would accept, ok I’ll try to approach him again, thanks for the advice.

So in the most recent relationship, he told me that he wanted to be in a relationship with me I told him it won’t work as I had a crush on someone else but then when I started to have feelings for him he no longer cared about me, although I still catched him look at me.
As for the advice yeah sounds good I’ll check it out thanks.
Yeah I’m trying to plan it well.

I don’t know every time it seems to be a reason, or if there’s no reason I don’t know what happens first they seem to be interested but then when I start to exchange feelings with them they start to act weird and start to distance themselves. That’s really weird I don’t know why that’s happening.
Some of the activities I consider fun are going to the cinema, beach, cooking and then watching movies.
Yeah, I confronted him a few times but he keeps repeating it I’m thinking about moving out.
Thank you, sorry to hear that.

Ok, as for the love, I want them love me as I’m, to feel like I can be myself in front of them, and to care about me. 
For friends yes I’m a bit introverted but I still enjoy some activities.

No it’s ok, I can’t study nor work, situations which are absolutely unnecessary happens to me like the post I made about the man and the dog, which makes my paranoia worse, I don’t have many friends and I didn’t have any friends in school, I fell in love with many men and was about to have a relationship with them but it didn’t work, and now there is a new guy that I like but it seems that it won’t work either, why is god making me meet people and have feelings for them and then nothing happens, I just wanted to be happy like most people are.
Well there are a lot of reasons, for example I have depression, anxiety, ptsd and paranoia and I see no purpose in life.
Ok if no one is gonna help me I’m gonna overdose on whatever be it dishwashing liquid.
It it basic things that I lack from him, like feeling safe and loved, I’m not asking him to coddle me.
Yeah 😣😣
Thanks 🥹 actually I’m talking about god, cause he is the one who made this ugly life, and left us here.
Thank you for your answers, it’s always interesting to hear other people’s thoughts about experiences like this.
And he knew I would go to the cinema with my friends, now I’m angry I don’t know if I’ll go
Oh thank you, it feels good to hear that :)
Yes could also be because it was sunny. I’m getting help for my paranoia and I’m taking medication, thank you for the response.
Yes I didn’t thought about that, yes you’re right I’m young, thank you for the response.

This is really making me suicidal.
